text: {"lessons":["After selling Stock B at a gain, I later bought it back at a higher price; I should make buy and sell decisions from a clear valuation and allocation plan, not from the satisfaction of realizing gains or fear of missing out.","Selling part of Stock A after a large rise reduced my exposure while leaving the rest invested; I should judge trims by portfolio balance and future prospects, not just the size of a paper gain.","My account can move sharply from month to month, and buying more during a downturn can add risk; I should check that each purchase fits my diversification and cash limits rather than react to recent price moves."]}
